messages:
alex_kaplan: Heads-up — seeing flaky score diffs when we bring up new model variants. Suspect eval-runner isn't invalidating promptset/fixture cache when promptset version changes. Repro: run `eval_runner --promptset=promptsets/v2 --runner=quantized`; scores unexpectedly match v1 once in a while.

maria_gomez: ugh. any logs?

alex_kaplan: pasted logs:
```
2026-03-20T15:12:03Z INFO runner: loading promptset promptsets/v2
2026-03-20T15:12:03Z INFO cache: hit key promptset:promptsets/latest (v1)
2026-03-20T15:12:03Z WARN outputs: 5/500 responses reused from cache
```
Looks like cache key uses 'latest' alias rather than versioned path.

jin_liu: @alex_kaplan can you check fixture metadata? we add fixtures by hash but CI sometimes reuses cached artifact IDs across shards.

samir_patel: saw something similar last month — CI shard reuses /tmp/fixtures across parallel jobs unless we use separate WORKSPACE_PER_JOB. Could be stale files.

maria_gomez: is this limited to quantized runners or happens on full fp16 too?

alex_kaplan: repro'd on both; quantized amplifies since output deduping more aggressive with smaller logits noise.

eval-bot: Test run 1790121020 finished: 3 cache hits in eval-runner on promptset:v2 — expected 0. https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/1790121020

jin_liu: suggest quick fix: include promptset git sha in the cache key: e.g. `promptset:{path}:{sha}`. Also add a CI guard: step that validates fixtures in ephemeral dir.

samir_patel: agree. also add a unit test for runner cache invalidation in eval-harness. We can simulate rename of promptset and assert cache miss.

maria_gomez: assignable items?

alex_kaplan: I'll open a PR to change cache key + update docs. @samir_patel can you add CI test? @jin_liu please audit other cache keys (model variant, quant) to ensure versioning.

samir_patel: on it. will add test to shard-12. ETA EOD.

jin_liu: will run a quick grep for `latest` in cache keys and open issues for any hits.

maria_gomez: thanks — can we add a post-deploy smoke that runs small eval and asserts no reused outputs?

alex_kaplan: yes. adding to rollout checklist. I'll include command and expected assertion in PR description.

maria_gomez: :thumbsup: 

alex_kaplan: filing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/842
